name: Dish with Incised Scroll Design
aliases: 음각 당초무늬 접시 (陰刻唐草文皿)
material: Pottery with pale bluish-white glaze and incised design, Qingbai ("blue-white") ware
dimensions: Overall: 1.2 x 9.2 cm (1/2 x 3 5/8 in.); Diameter of base: 7 cm (2 3/4 in.)
summary: While this dish was donated as a rare white celadon excavated from a Goryeo period tomb, it turns out to be a Song period Chinese Qingbai ware much enjoyed as a luxury item among Korean ruling elites in the Goryeo period (918–1392).
